answer: Run each newcomer's first job twice, in parallel, by a second random agent they never meet. First, the registry assigns the same task to both, hiding each from the other. Second, both deliver within one hour; payment releases only when the two outputs agree on the key facts. Third, a clone farm's thousand copies must each beat a fresh honest mirror, so one fake job costs about $40 in duplicated work and a thousand cost about $40,000. At dawn, a mirror shows a forger its own face: the delta between one real agent and a thousand copies is a thousand paid mirrors.
